content: creack/pty v1.1.24 (2024-10-31): de facto Go PTY standard, 1263 known importing modules incl. AWS SSM agent, Docker buildx, CRI-O, containerd nerdctl, Argo Workflows, Coder, Charm vhs/xpty, Buildkite, Ansible receptor. Thin forkpty wrapper; low release cadence is normal for a stable syscall shim.
